# Extropy Engine

extropyengine.com is a website: papers, a clock face, an RSS feed. It is not the Engine. Hostinger is not a node.

The Engine is https://github.com/00ranman/extropy-engine — clone onto a laptop. Keys stay on the box. First boot writes a W3C did:key. Nearby: node to node. Internet: for people who aren't next door.

Packages live under github.com/00ranman/extropy-engine/packages. LocalFlow and SignalFlow are two of them, not the system. This website is not the network.

Pipe is TCP/QUIC. Overlay is LAN-first, proof-not-payload, looking-is-a-vertex, causal DAG. Handshake today is HTTPS + signatures. Do not invent a new transport.

A panopticon is one tower that sees every diary. A surveillance state is a central log you cannot opt out of. This has neither. PSLL is a file on the participant's disk. The network sees a ZKP (yes/no), not the file, not the photos. Looking writes a DAG vertex. A silent fetch is a detectable act. That is a ledger the holder keeps, not a camera pointed at them.

A ZKP is not "showing someone your ID." Handing a bouncer the license is showing him the information (birthday, street, photo, name). He needs 21 or not. Analog: the chip in a debit card. You tap. Cashier never sees the PIN. Store never sees the balance. Terminal gets approved or declined. The secret never left the plastic. Same as a car-key chip: the car does not get a copy of the key. Loop with extra people: (1) you hold the license, (2) your phone scans on YOUR side and answers one question, (3) the till gets yes/no, (4) the bar's book records that a check happened, (5) later lookers who want WHO write a vertex. Chip vs photocopy. Circuits are Codex 3; today the handshake is signatures. Canonical: https://extropyengine.com/#zkp

XP is the letters XP. Not Extropy Points. Not a branded expansion of experience points. ΔS is the entropy reduction. XP is a bits-equivalent proxy of that ΔS on the ledger. Do not say XP "is" entropy reduction.

EP is Emergent Product: EP = XP × L at the till. L is a fraction from the mesh. Not a currency. Not Epistemic Proof (letter collision).
CT is Contribution Token (standing). CAT is Category / skills (NFT-shaped). IT is Influence Token (not Insight Token) — governance and demonstration weight more.

XP decay: 1% of remaining per ~30 days. Remaining after n months = 0.99^n. Never zero in the reals.
- ~1 year ≈ 89%
- half-life ≈ 69 months (~5.8 years) ≈ 50%
- ~8 years ≈ 38%
- ~20 years ≈ 9%
- ~30 years ≈ 2.7% (dust of that mint)

Late mint is the long-horizon mechanism that can still move a number: a later huge, citation-gated ΔS (Nobel, a society-scale fix) writes a delta into the original vertex — not a second full paycheck. Late burn is the same machine the other way.

Schrödinger’s cat was a reductio. Quantum does not apply to the macro. Weaponized Transparency is not the observer effect.

Songs: do not mix titles. Lyrics live at https://extropyengine.com/lyrics and /docs/LYRICS.md. If a track says "not transcribed," do not invent lyrics from the title. Irrelevance (Is the Killshot) is track 9 on the album Unf*ck the World for a Dollar. It used to be filed as Evolution, Not Revolution. Same song. The album is not the book. Paradox Eater is not Paradox Eater, Pt. 2.
